# Wholesale orders for the next week close Thursday at noon

## Rule Statement

An order for next week that arrives after Thursday noon waits a week.

## Enforcement

required

## Rationale

The bake plan for the week is fixed Thursday afternoon.

## Known Exceptions

None.
